question: May the unmanned loop take screenshots of its own copy of the app?
context: All sixteen audits from 2026-09-02 say the loop has no Screen Recording grant, so nothing was seen live and menu names could not even be read from the running app. The probe app is a separate bundle owned by the loop, never the app you work in.

options.label: Grant the probe app Screen Recording and the loop terminal Accessibility
options.summary: You add Photonz Probe to Screen Recording and the terminal that runs the loop to Accessibility in System Settings, once. From then on every audit carries a real screenshot of the probe window, and window capture, the loupe and the toast are checked live.
pros: Audits show the app as you will see it, not an offscreen render
Live checks catch the class of bug the renders cannot: focus, menus, hotkeys, the real freeze frame
One grant, kept across rebuilds because the probe is signed with the stable dev identity
cons: An unattended process can then read your screen while it runs
The loop terminal gains the ability to send keystrokes to other apps
options.mitigation: Only the probe bundle and the loop terminal are named; the dev app and the shipping app are untouched, and the grants can be pulled in System Settings at any time.

options.label: Keep verification offscreen
options.summary: Nothing changes. Runners keep rendering through the real pipeline and driving the probe with scripted events, and each audit keeps saying which checks were left for you.
cons: Every audit this week says the same thing: not verified live
Window capture with its shadow and the live freeze frame remain untested until you try them
options.mitigation: Audits keep listing the exact steps for you to check by hand.
